title: A/R Detail: an expanded bucket shows 100 lines, then loads more on scroll
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • One aging bucket, {Bucket-A}, has more than 150 open lines on today's date.
    For example: {Bucket-A} is "91 or more days past due" on the QA organization.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with every bucket collapsed.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand {Bucket-A} with its own chevron.
  2. Count the lines shown in {Bucket-A} before any more load (or compare them with the bucket's first 100 rows in a CSV export).
  3. Scroll further down.
  4. Collapse {Bucket-A} with its own chevron.
  5. Click the chevron button in the top-left header cell (Expand all).
  6. Count the lines shown in {Bucket-A} before any more load.
  7. Scroll further down.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Bucket-A} opens.
  • Step 2: it shows its first 100 lines.
  • Step 3: more lines load as you scroll, continuing the same order with no line repeated.
  • Step 4: {Bucket-A} closes.
  • Step 5: every bucket expands.
  • Step 6: {Bucket-A} again shows its first 100 lines.
  • Step 7: more lines load as you scroll.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R4: “On A/R Detail and A/P Detail, expanding a bucket (by hand or with Expand all) shows its first 100 lines, then loads more as the user scrolls. This is as today on A/P Detail and new on A/R Detail, which today shows a whole bucket at once.”
  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors per page. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”
